verdict.rationale: Bland's TTS docs say you can clone your own voice from a clean sample of about ten seconds and set its defaults alongside built-in voices, so the core cloning capability is documented. Nothing in the pack documents a consent or verification process for cloning, and the docs do not explicitly show a cloned voice being assigned to an agent. Missing for 10: documented consent/verification process for voice cloning, explicit evidence of assigning cloned voices to agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
